summary: T31 retains exact fail-closed host identity and rejects any post-seal loader mutation while allowing a bytecode-free real authority readback.
facts: An injected runtime/scripts/kb/__pycache__/agent-runtime.cpython-313.pyc makes the installer reject the sealed tree and roll back instead of deleting or ignoring the mutation.
Future, substring, wrapper, executable alias, help, profile, broker, generation and recomputed-authority drift remain rejected before provider launch or successful install.
A production-mode runpy smoke must return the authority defined only inside the installed entrypoint and leaves zero __pycache__ or .pyc entries.
